name: EPIC 245947301
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 12, 9.8 solar radii and 0.85 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 245947301 (K2 campaign 12): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.799278 (16th-84th percentiles 9.585804-10.125826), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 245947301 (K2 campaign 12): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.853295 (16th-84th percentiles 0.813058-0.921676), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 245947301: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4594.357 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 245947301 (K2 campaign 12): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2218.046875 (16th-84th percentiles 2176.484375-2269.570312), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.03 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 2,218 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.85 solar masses and 9.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,594 K at its surface.
